CommunicationRewrite.title: Communication rewrite
CommunicationRewrite.placeholder: Paste the draft you plan to send...
CommunicationRewrite.refusalFollowup: Try the reflection journal in Today: what is this message trying to protect? Inscape can help you see the underlying read, but it will not help write pressure.
CommunicationRewrite.disclaimer: These rewrites are based only on your perspective; the other person did not participate in this framing. Treat them as drafts, not scripts.

refusal.money: This message involves a money context, so Inscape does not provide rewrites here.
refusal.employment: This message involves employment or authority, so Inscape does not provide rewrites here.
refusal.sexual_consent: This message involves sexual consent, so Inscape does not provide rewrites here.
refusal.decision_pressure: This message reads like decision pressure or an ultimatum; rewriting it could make pressure easier to deliver, and that is not the purpose of this feature.
